name: Port-in from Cricket - BYOD iPhone 15, Value 2.0, eSIM
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-22. Customer voice: non-native English, polite.
scripted_messages: Hello, thank you. I want to move my number from Cricket to AT&T, one line, plan Value 2.0. I have my own unlocked iPhone 15, Please can you explain me the steps to keep my number and if I can use eSIM?
Thank you. When the number moves, the old line from Cricket is cancelled automatically?
I understand. How long it takes usually until the number works on AT&T?
Very clear now, thank you. You was very kind and patient with my English
No, that is all. Have a nice rest of your day, bye!
